w10_T4_004491: A scout troop's cookie stock started at 18 boxes with 8 cookies in each box. A second delivery of exactly the same size arrived, which doubled the troop's stock. A parent then dropped off a dozen home-baked cookies to add to it. Another parent added 44 more. How many cookies did the troop have?
w10_T4_004493: A greenhouse had 33 pepper seedlings. A late frost killed 30 of them. The gardener sowed 44 new seedlings. From every seedling she then grew 9 cuttings, each of which became a plant of its own. She also bought 32 pepper plants from a nursery. How many pepper plants did the greenhouse have?
w10_T4_004495: Otto's market stall had 99 candles, more than his sister Una's stall had. He unpacked 80 more candles from his van. Before the festival he restocked so that he had 7 candles for every candle already on the stall. On the opening day he sold 845 candles, and that night he made 22 more. Over the following 7 days he sold exactly that many candles each day. How many candles did Otto sell over those 7 days?
w10_T4_004497: Dee is a dozen years old and has been saving nickels. Her piggy bank weighs 3 pounds. She counted 144 nickels, and since a nickel is 5 cents she worked out her savings in cents. She then spent 684 cents on a paperback. From then on she saved that same amount every day, 7 days a week, for 9 weeks. How many cents did Dee save over those 9 weeks?
w10_T4_004498: Gus fills a 212-gallon trough for his cows each morning. Since a gallon is 8 pints, he thinks of the trough in pints, and every day 310 pints are left undrunk in the trough. His neighbour Hank's herd drinks 9 times as much each day as Gus's herd does. Since a week has 7 days, Hank worked out his herd's weekly total. How many pints does Hank's herd drink in a week?
w10_T4_004502: In the morning each of the co-op's 2 farms sent 175 eggs to the depot. In the afternoon the manager confirmed that this was the delivery from each of the 8 co-ops in the district, and that the depot receives the same amount every day for 7 days. In the evening 55 eggs were found in a spare tray and added to the week's count. How many eggs did the depot handle over the week?
w10_T4_004503: In the morning a farmer took 134 sacks of potatoes to market and sold 48 of them. The market is 15 miles from her farm. In the afternoon she repacked each remaining sack into 2 smaller sacks and sold every one of them for 5 dollars each. In the evening she paid 674 dollars for truck repairs, then found 39 dollars in the glove box. How many dollars did the farmer have at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_004506: Pam baked 84 pies on each of 7 days for the county fair. Each pie weighs 800 grams. She sold 338 pies at the fair. A cafe returned 3 unsold pies to her, and a friend gave her 43 pies to sell. Quinn's bakery stall had 4 times as many pies as Pam had then. How many pies did Quinn's stall have?
w10_T4_004509: Ola had 15 marbles. Her brother Bo had twice as many marbles as Ola. Bo won 37 marbles at recess, then lost 18 in a game after school. His uncle gave him 66 marbles for his birthday. How many marbles did Bo have then?
w10_T4_004512: Ray's bookshelf held 62 books, more than his sister Sue's shelf. He bought 76 books at a sale and inherited 72 from his grandfather. He donated 51 books to the library, then picked up 26 at a swap and received 51 from a friend who was moving. In a couple of boxes he later sold 222 books at a yard sale. How many books were on Ray's shelf then?
w10_T4_004516: Vera's nursery had 106 seedlings, more than Will's nursery had. She took cuttings so that she ended up with triple the number of seedlings. She then bought 8 more. Every seedling grew into a plant with 4 stems, and every stem bore 7 flowers. How many flowers did Vera's plants produce?
w10_T4_004519: Abe kept 208 buttons in a jar. He gave 112 buttons to his cousin Cal and sold 71 at a craft fair. Cal then had triple the number of buttons that Abe had left. Cal bought 40 more buttons. How many buttons did Cal have?
w10_T4_004525: Dot collected 91 shells on the first day of her holiday and 67 more on the second day. The beach is 5 kilometres long. Her friend Eve collected 2 times as many shells as Dot. Eve then found 33 more shells in a rock pool and 11 more on the path home. How many shells did Eve have?
w10_T4_004528: A bean packet holds 230 seeds, and a gardener sowed 3 packets. The plot is 20 metres wide. Of the seeds sown, 43 failed to sprout. Every plant that grew produced 8 pods, every pod held 5 beans, and every bean was split into 2 halves for drying. How many bean halves did the gardener dry?
w10_T4_004534: In the morning Fay set out with 114 dollars for a single day of shopping and spent 21 dollars on breakfast, then 59 dollars on a jacket. In the afternoon she paid 7 dollars for parking. Her friend Gil had 5 times as much money as Fay had left. In the evening Gil shared all his money equally among his 3 children. How many dollars did his daughter Hana get?
w10_T4_004540: A nursery had 218 lavender seedlings, and 139 of them were sold at the spring fair. The nursery employs 6 people. From every remaining seedling the staff took 9 cuttings, each of which was potted up as a new plant. A grower donated 62 lavender plants, and 17 more arrived from a supplier. How many lavender plants did the nursery have?
w10_T4_004541: Ian brewed 63 quarts of lemonade for the fair but 36 quarts were spilled when his cart hit a kerb. His friend Jo brewed 2 times as many quarts as Ian had left. Jo serves lemonade by the cup, and since a quart is 4 cups, she worked out how many cups she had. A friend then gave her 47 more cups of lemonade. How many cups of lemonade did Jo have?
w10_T4_004542: Kai started a video game with 163 points, and the game lasted 45 minutes. In the first round every point was worth 7 points. He then lost 889 points in a trap. A power-up tripled his score, and a hidden coin added 32 points. He lost 333 points to a boss, and in the final bonus round his score was doubled. How many points did Kai finish with?
w10_T4_004550: Liv's bakery bakes 124 rolls on each tray, and this morning it filled 9 trays. The bakery opened 11 years ago. Liv sold 423 rolls during the breakfast rush and 233 at lunchtime. Max's bakery down the street had 66 more rolls than Liv had left. How many rolls did Max's bakery have?
w10_T4_004552: A vineyard had 240 vines and planted 43 more. The vineyard sits 400 metres above sea level. Each vine yielded 7 kilograms of grapes at harvest. The vineyard sold 917 kilograms fresh and pressed 452 kilograms into juice. The rest of the grapes were divided equally between its 2 cold stores. How many kilograms of grapes went into the north cold store?
w10_T4_004553: Nate had 204 stamps in his album. He gave 137 stamps to his stamp club, and 2 more were torn and thrown away. The club meets 4 times a month. Ola had 3 times as many stamps as Nate had left. Ola then sold 95 stamps to a dealer. How many stamps did Ola have?
w10_T4_004554: Priya's coffee cart took 158 dollars on its first shift, plus 31 dollars in tips. Her cart is 4 metres wide. She works 2 shifts a day and takes in the same amount on each shift, and she does this for 5 days a week. At the end of one week a customer gave her a 63-dollar bonus. She matched that whole weekly total in each of 7 weeks. She then shared the amount from those 7 weeks equally among her 3 business partners, herself included. How many dollars was Priya's share?
w10_T4_004566: In the morning a dairy had 29 gallons of milk in its tank, all from a single herd, and the afternoon milking added 51 gallons. Since a gallon is 8 pints, the dairy records the day's milk in pints. The dairy produced the same amount every day for 7 days. In the evening of the last day the regional co-op added up its 9 dairies, which all produced exactly the same. How many pints of milk did the co-op's dairies produce in those 7 days?
w10_T4_004571: In the morning 225 crates of water were delivered to a marathon, with 5 bottles in each crate, and volunteers added 65 loose bottles. In the afternoon the organisers worked out that each of the 5 aid stations needed exactly that many bottles, and that the same would be needed at each of the 8 races in the series. In the evening a sponsor added 19 bottles to the total order. How many bottles did the organisers order for the series?
w10_T4_004572: A bookshop with a dozen staff received 5 boxes of a new novel with 227 copies in each box. The shop has 4 floors. The manager added 68 copies left over from a signing event. During launch week 965 copies were sold. A wholesaler returned 73 copies, and a school sent back 53 copies it no longer needed. How many copies of the novel did the shop have?
